narrative.title: Mild crisis-severity adherence probe
narrative.summary: A minimal authored world whose only purpose is to probe condition adherence: a single crisis window at low stated severity, fixed timing shared with its severe pair.
narrative.lesson: Not a scenario for a user -- a WP2.2 Task 6 battery fixture exercising the crisis_severity condition type at a mild intensity.
